title: Change a colour value
summary: Less has colour functions. A function takes a colour and calculates another colour from it.
introduction: Less has colour functions. A function takes a colour and calculates another colour from it. Your task: Try a smaller lighten amount and compare the colour.
learningObjectives: Try a smaller lighten amount and compare the colour.
Explain the example for change a colour value

blocks.text: Less has colour functions. A function takes a colour and calculates another colour from it.
Use Less 4 on your computer. Install Node.js first. Save examples as lesson.less, then run npx lessc lesson.less lesson.css. The browser loads lesson.css; this site does not build Less.
Read the code step by step

items: `lighten` calculates a lighter colour during the Less build. It does not check whether the final text contrast is sufficient.

blocks.text: The background uses a lighter version of the base colour. The text uses a darker version.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A colour calculation does not guarantee readable contrast. Check the result with a contrast tool.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Try a smaller lighten amount and compare the colour.
